Title: SFTP support for Azure Blob Storage - now in public preview

Body.Content:
Starting today, SSH File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) support for Azure Blob Storage is available for public preview in select regions.

Azure Blob Storage now supports SFTP over object storage, enabling you to leverage object storage economics and features. With multi-protocol support, you can run your applications on a single storage platform with no application rewrites necessary, therefore eliminating data silos.

To learn more, refer to documentation: SFTP support for Azure Blob Storage.
